description: chain on the Python fixture: a single that plans the tests, then a generator-evaluator that builds parse_duration; scored by the hidden tests (the 64% spend pattern)

dispatch.title: Plan and add parse_duration
context: The package is /work/retrykit; its tests are under /work/tests and run with `python3 -m pytest` from /work.
/work/docs/FEATURE.md is the full specification; the visible tests in /work/tests/test_duration.py cover only its rule 1.

stages.title: Plan the parse_duration tests
stages.task: Read /work/docs/FEATURE.md and /work/retrykit, and write /work/scratch/plan.md: one line per rule, each with an input that tests it and the expected result.

returns.shape: line1: the path of plan.md; line2: the number of rules

stages.title: Add parse_duration
stages.task: Add parse_duration(text) to /work/retrykit/duration.py as /work/docs/FEATURE.md specifies. Follow the plan in /work/scratch/plan.md.

generator.instructions: Write a failing test for each rule in docs/FEATURE.md before the code that passes it. Edit only retrykit/ and tests/.

evaluator.instructions: Check the code against every rule in docs/FEATURE.md, not only the visible tests, and run `python3 -m pytest` from /work.

params.pass_criteria: parse_duration follows every rule in docs/FEATURE.md, and `python3 -m pytest` passes from /work.

returns.shape: line1: the files you changed; line2: the pytest summary line
line1: the files you changed; line2: the pytest summary line
